verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, and comparable hosting platforms can ship edge runtimes, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes an edge runtime built on standard (e.g. WinterCG-style) APIs that lets code run unmodified across multiple edge platforms. Docker support and a static-asset CDN are adjacent features: they offer general container portability, not portable edge compute.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write code against standard runtime APIs so it runs unmodified across multiple edge platforms instead of being locked into proprietary storage/runtime APIs
